parsed.explanation: No criminalisation of trans identity and discrimination on grounds of gender reassignment remains protected, so risk of arrest or state violence is low. But the dossier documents state-imposed, traveller-facing universal exposures with no working remedy: the 2025 ruling that 'sex' in the equality act is biological, driving the statutory single-sex-spaces code covering changing rooms, hostels and single-sex services; strip-search policy by sex at birth (transport and regional police); custody segregation by birth sex after guidance was struck down; and announced bans on trans patients in single-sex wards, with one documented death after a trans woman was removed from a cancer ward. Hostile media climate and unresolved challenges add weight without reaching an organised-targeting tier.
